senses.gloss: אוֹסִיף, אוֹסֵף same, to add, increase; to do again.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 8:10">Targ. Gen. VIII, 10</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 116b">Sabb. 116ᵇ</cite> <he>אנא</he> … <he>אלא לאוֹסָפֵי וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) I have not come to diminish from but to add to the law of Moses.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:1:26">Y. Ber. IV, 7ᶜ</cite> <he>אוֹסְפוּן עליה</he> add thereto.—Part. pass. <cite ref="M00548"><he>מוֹסַף</he></cite>, f. <cite ref="M00549"><he>מוֹסְפָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 20a">Kidd. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>והא מ׳ ואזלא</he> but this (the debt on interest) is continually growing; a. fr.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 49:26">Targ. Gen. XLIX, 26</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 28a:3">Ber. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>אִתּוֹסְפוּ כמה ספסלי</he> many forms had to be added (to accommodate the hearers).
<cite ref="Berakhot 28a">Ib.</cite> <he>א׳ ד׳ מאהוכ׳</he> four hundred forms were added; a. e.
